scope: Main product capabilities supported by repository evidence, not individual fixes or an exhaustive UI inventory. Hypothetical enhancements are not an approved backlog.

status_definitions.pass: Implemented with local test evidence. Does not establish hosted OAuth, remote database configuration or deployment health.
status_definitions.in-progress: Partial implementation exists, but the feature is not complete or available to users.
status_definitions.not-started: An explicitly scoped future feature with no implementation yet. No such features are currently recorded here.

last_recorded_full_run.result: 150 unit/component tests, 57 SQL assertions and 4 desktop/mobile browser cases passed, plus typecheck, lint and production build.

verification.external_checks: Hosted Google OAuth, remote permissions/migrations, live Pokepaste and deployed Pages remain unverified. Use the external acceptance procedure in the verification guide.

features.name: Google sign-in and user profile
features.description: Enter through Google OAuth, restore the Supabase session, update the profile username and sign out, with recoverable sign-in errors.
limits: Browser integration uses a local password-session fixture; real Google OAuth and Google-only API enforcement require external verification.

features.name: Personal own and opponent team libraries
features.description: Save, view, search, edit and delete teams with source labels in My teams and Opponents, with database ownership isolation. Saving an own team also adds it to Opponents.
limits: Personal searches still assemble the entire library in the client; source labels are not folders.

features.name: Showdown and Pokepaste team import
features.description: Import pasted Showdown team text or a Pokepaste link, parse sets and validate Champions species, moves, abilities, items, natures, level and stat-point limits before saving.
limits: Pokepaste fetch tests use fixtures; live service availability needs an external check. Supported data is Champions-specific.

features.name: Manual team building and set editing
features.description: Create or edit teams, add/remove/reorder members, change legal sets and stat spreads, and view level-50/base stats and regular or Mega forms.
limits: Sets are saved as members of teams; there is no separate personal library of individual sets.

features.name: Popular team catalog and administration
features.description: Browse and load Popular teams with paginated source/name/species search and suggestions. The designated confirmed administrator manages the catalog under database RLS.
limits: Real RLS/RPC checks cover the disposable local stack; hosted configuration has not been verified.

features.name: Champions damage calculator and battle workspace
features.description: Load own/opponent rosters and calculate damage ranges, rolls, KO projections and HP effects using @smogon/calc generation 0. Adjust forms, abilities, field conditions, HP and stages; restore the per-user workspace and start a new battle on desktop or mobile.
limits: Current calculations select one attacker and one defender, not a combined attack from two Pokemon. HP and stages are temporary; New battle keeps My Team and clears opponents, field and observations.

features.name: Opponent set estimation from observed damage
features.description: Record damage dealt as percent and damage received as HP, fit opponent spreads against observations, and compare estimates with bulky, fast or offensive presets.
limits: An estimate is a fitted candidate, not proof of the opponent's actual set. Observations using temporary HP/stages are not persisted.

features.name: Individual Pokemon loading with common sets
features.description: Search and add one or several Pokemon to a calculator roster using per-species common sets derived from Popular teams, with a deterministic legal default when no common set is available.
limits: Common sets summarize the catalog; adding a Pokemon to the calculator does not save an individual personal set.

features.name: AI-assisted team selection
features.description: Existing groundwork for selecting four Pokemon and lead order from a matchup summary through a server-side Gemini request and cache.
limits: No UI/client caller is wired up. The response schema is not applied by the Edge Function, the fallback returns no selected Pokemon, and automated recommendation acceptance coverage is absent. Not a shipped feature.
